```{r}
library(usethis)
library(devtools)
library(ape)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(phytools)
```

```{r}
#install the package for making the phylogenetic tree
#install_github("jinyizju/V.PhyloMaker")
library(V.PhyloMaker)
```

```{r}
#now I need to get my cleaned list of species, with a species, genus and family column

#make a vector of species
all_traits_database <- read.csv(here("processed trait data", "all traits database.csv"))
```

```{r}
list_with_traits <- all_traits_database %>%
  select(binomial_name, genus, family, seed_length_mm, mean_dry_seed_mass_mg) %>%
  # Ensure characters are valid UTF-8, replace non-breaking spaces
  mutate(
    binomial_name = iconv(binomial_name, from = "", to = "UTF-8"),       # fix encoding
    binomial_name = gsub("\u00A0", " ", binomial_name, useBytes = TRUE)  # replace NBSP
  ) %>%
  # Remove unwanted placeholders
  filter(!grepl(
    "(?i)\\bunknown\\b|\\bmixed\\b|\\b(species|sp)\\.?\\s*\\d*$",
    binomial_name
  )) %>%
  # Drop rows with NA binomial_name
  filter(!is.na(binomial_name)) %>%
  rename(species = "binomial_name")

list_sp_cleaned <- list_with_traits %>%
  select(-seed_length_mm, -mean_dry_seed_mass_mg)


```

```{r}
result <- phylo.maker(list_sp_cleaned, scenarios=c("S1","S2","S3"))


# Extract each scenario as a separate phylo object
Scenario1_tree <- result$scenario.1
Scenario2_tree <- result$scenario.2$run.1
Scenario3_tree <- result$scenario.3

# Check classes
class(Scenario1_tree)  #should be class "phylo"
class(Scenario2_tree)
class(Scenario3_tree)
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot.phylo(result$scenario.1, cex = 1.5, main = "scenario.1", show.tip.label = FALSE)
#nodelabels(round(branching.times(result$scenario.1), 1), cex = 1)
plot.phylo(result$scenario.2[[1]], cex = 1.5, main = "scenario.2", show.tip.label= FALSE)
plot.phylo(result$scenario.3, cex = 1.5, main = "scenario.3", show.tip.label= FALSE)
# plot a circular tree
#plot.phylo(result$scenario.1, type = "fan", cex = 0.5, show.tip.label = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#calculate the log of the seed mass
log_seed_mass <- log(setNames(list_with_traits$mean_dry_seed_mass_mg, list_with_traits$species))

#fix the names
names(log_seed_mass) <- gsub(" ", "_", names(log_seed_mass))

#now calculate pagel's lambda, using scenario 1
common_species <- intersect(names(log_seed_mass), Scenario1_tree$tip.label)
log_seed_mass <- log_seed_mass[common_species]
Scenario1_tree <- drop.tip(Scenario1_tree, setdiff(Scenario1_tree$tip.label, common_species))

#calculate pagel's lambda
lambda_seed_mass <- phylosig(Scenario1_tree, log_seed_mass, method = "lambda", test = TRUE)
print(lambda_seed_mass)   

#value is very close to 0.989, showing that it is very strongly phylogenetically conserved

```

```{r}
data("GBOTB.extended")

sp_df <- list_sp_cleaned

# Helper to standardize strings
norm_space <- function(x) trimws(tolower(gsub("_", " ", x)))
norm_unders <- function(x) trimws(tolower(gsub(" ", "_", x)))

backbone_tips <- GBOTB.extended$tip.label

# Species present (make both sides comparable)
is_sp_present <- norm_space(sp_df$species) %in% norm_space(backbone_tips)

# Extract genera from backbone tips (convert underscores -> spaces, then take first word)
backbone_genera <- unique(sub(" .*", "", gsub("_", " ", backbone_tips)))
is_genus_present <- tolower(sp_df$genus) %in% tolower(backbone_genera)

n_total        <- nrow(sp_df)
n_present      <- sum(is_sp_present)
n_insert_genus <- sum(!is_sp_present & is_genus_present)
n_insert_fam   <- sum(!is_sp_present & !is_genus_present)  # effectively "family-level" insertions
n_insert_total <- n_insert_genus + n_insert_fam

cat("Total species:", n_total, "\n")
cat("Present in backbone:", n_present, "\n")
cat("Inserted at genus:", n_insert_genus, "\n")
cat("Inserted at family:", n_insert_fam, "\n")
cat("Total inserted (estimated):", n_insert_total, "\n")
```
